item.book_of_sins.sin_tome.binding: This is the original sin, beyond forgiveness.
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome.unremovable: Once equipped, it can never be removed.
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_pride.lore:
"Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall."
"For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased."
Kings of old claimed to stand equal with gods,
and fell from the highest heavens into dust.
- Proverbs 16:18 / Luke 14:11
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_pride.1: 1. Fall damage taken: 5% chance to be doubled, 1% quadrupled, 0.1% octupled
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_pride.2: 2. Monsters take notice of you from 5 blocks farther away
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_pride.3: 3. Sin tomes cannot be removed once equipped
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_pride.5: 5. Archaeology may spawn monsters or destroy suspicious blocks
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_pride.6: 6. No natural healing for 1s after taking damage
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_pride.7: 7. 5% of your arrows strike back at you
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_envy.lore:
"Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous;
but who is able to stand before envy?"
Cain slew his brother in the field,
for the Lord had respect unto Abel's offering.
The envious eye corrodes its own socket first.
- Proverbs 27:4 / Genesis 4:8
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_envy.1: 1. +10% damage taken from creatures holding items
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_envy.2: 2. -30% damage dealt to targets with more health than you
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_envy.3: 3. Each empty ender chest slot: -1 enchantment level
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_envy.4: 4. Tool durability drains twice as fast
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_envy.5: 5. Armor below 50% durability may break instantly when you are hurt
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_wrath.lore:
"Make no friendship with an angry man;
and with a furious man thou shalt not go."
"For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God."
The blade drawn in fury
shall pierce its wielder's own breast.
- Proverbs 22:24 / James 1:20
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_wrath.2: 2. Single hits exceeding your max health hurt you for 5% of the damage
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_wrath.3: 3. Each hit stacks -5% attack speed for 3s (stacks infinitely)
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_wrath.4: 4. -1% damage per block of distance to the target
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_wrath.7: 7. Any hit deals at least 20% of your max health
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_sloth.lore:
"Go to the ant, thou sluggard;
consider her ways, and be wise."
"Yet a little sleep, a little slumber,
so shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth."
The sluggard's years rot away within his dreams.
- Proverbs 6:6 / Proverbs 6:10-11
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_sloth.2: 2. 30% chance to be thrown out of bed, sleepless until dawn
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_sloth.3: 3. Waking up grants 5 random negative effects
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_sloth.5: 5. Each day without sleep: -5% movement and damage
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_sloth.6: 6. Mining may inflict Mining Fatigue III for 10s
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_sloth.7: 7. Teleporting locks you in place for 3s
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_greed.lore:
"For the love of money is the root of all evil:
which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith,
and pierced themselves through with many sorrows."
"For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world,
and lose his own soul?"
The hoarder is buried together with his gold.
- 1 Timothy 6:10 / Mark 8:36
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_greed.3: 3. Loot chests yield half the loot
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_greed.4: 4. Villager trades doubled in price, never restock
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_greed.6: 6. Picking up items deals 1 damage to you
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_greed.7: 7. Opening functional blocks deals 5 damage to you
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_gluttony.lore:
"Whose God is their belly,
and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things."
Every feast must come to an end,
yet the glutton's maw is never satisfied.
- Philippians 3:19
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_gluttony.1: 1. Below full hunger: no healing, no damage dealt
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_gluttony.3: 3. Eating food hurts you for its nutrition value
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_gluttony.4: 4. Food in your inventory occasionally vanishes
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_gluttony.5: 5. Food restores only half its hunger and saturation; status effects are unaffected
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_lust.lore:
"When lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin:
and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death."
The burning flame of desire lights up the night,
and in its ashes nothing survives.
- James 1:15 / Matthew 5:28
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_lust.3: 3. Once frozen (e.g. by powder snow), you stay frozen forever
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_lust.4: 4. Piglins refuse to trade with you
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_lust.5: 5. Your first strike in a fight deals -99% damage
item.book_of_sins.sin_tome_lust.6: 6. One permanent random buff, re-rolled hourly
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_pride.3: "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble." - James 4:6
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_envy.2: While sprinting, damage taken is capped at 50% of your max health
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_envy.3: "A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones." - Proverbs 14:30
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_wrath.3: "An angry person stirs up conflict, and a hot-tempered person commits many sins." - Proverbs 29:22
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_sloth.3: "As a door turns on its hinges, so a slacker turns on his bed." - Proverbs 26:14
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_greed.2: Per point of Luck: +1% crit chance, +1 Fortune, +1 Looting
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_greed.3: "Be on your guard against all kinds of greed." - Luke 12:15
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_gluttony.2: Per food eaten: +1 max health; per 5: +1 armor; per 10: +1% attack speed / draw speed; per 50: +1% final damage; per 100: +1 Luck
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_gluttony.3: "If you find yourself hungry, put a knife to your throat." - Proverbs 23:2
item.book_of_sins.root_seal_lust.3: "I made a covenant with my eyes not to look lustfully at a young woman." - Job 31:1
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome.removabl: The turning of fate is complete; you may unequip it at any time.
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_pride.lo:
"Before a downfall the heart is haughty, but humility comes before honor."
"In humility value others above yourselves."
The ancient king once claimed to be equal with the divine,
now he bows to the dust and finds his lost crown.
- Proverbs 29:23 / Philippians 2:3
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_pride.3: 3. Each equipped Reversal Tome grants +3% final damage
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_pride.4: 4. Creatures you have tamed have their max health doubled
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_pride.5: 5.50% chance to yield double loot while brushing
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_pride.6: 6. Restore 10% of max health 1 second after taking damage
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_envy.lor:
"A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones."
"Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy."
The fire in the field has long been extinguished;
now he learns to rejoice in his brother's harvest.
- Proverbs 14:30 / 1 Corinthians 13:4
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_envy.1: 1. Take 10% less damage from creatures holding items
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_envy.2: 2. Deal 10% more damage when the target's health is higher than yours
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_envy.3: 3.+5 attack damage per unique item in your ender chest
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_envy.5: 5. Armor below 50% durability repairs 5 points every 10 seconds
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_envy.6: 6. When attack speed is above 3, +10% movement speed
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_envy.7: 7. When movement speed is above 3, +10% attack speed / draw speed
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_wrath.lo:
"Whoever is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a hasty temper exalts folly."
"Human anger does not produce the righteousness that God desires."
The unsheathed rage is reforged into a plowshare;
the barren field of the heart finally bears wheat.
- Proverbs 14:29 / James 1:20
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_wrath.2: 2. When your dealt damage exceeds your own max health, heal for 5% of it
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_wrath.3: 3. Each attack hit grants +5% attack speed and draw speed for 3 seconds, stacking up to 5 times
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_wrath.4: 4. Deal 0.1% more damage per block of distance to the target
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_wrath.5: 5. Your life steal is increased by 10%
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_wrath.7: 7.5% of damage taken is converted into healing for you
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome.jei_seal: After the reversal, the matching Root Seal can never be equipped again.
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_sloth.lo:
"Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!"
"Diligent hands will rule."
The eyelids that slept for a thousand years finally tremble;
the ant's trail stretches into a map of stars beneath his feet.
- Proverbs 6:6 / Proverbs 13:4
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_sloth.1: 1.3% chance to land an extra attack when dealing damage
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_sloth.2: 2. Sleeping restores you to full health
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_sloth.3: 3. Waking up grants 1 random positive buff for 60 seconds
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_sloth.4: 4. All attributes +10% for 60 seconds after respawning
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_sloth.5: 5. While phantoms could spawn for you, +10% movement speed
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_sloth.6: 6. Chance to gain Haste III for 10 seconds while mining
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_sloth.7: 7. After teleporting, gain 3 seconds of invulnerability (1 minute cooldown)
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_greed.lo:
"It is more blessed to give than to receive."
"Be on your guard against all kinds of greed."
Piles of gold coins are worth less than a single act of giving;
an open palm holds up the whole sky.
- Acts 20:35 / Luke 12:15
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_greed.2: 2.5% chance to gain a random common ore while mining (iron, gold, copper; amount scales with Fortune)
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_greed.3: 3. Loot from treasure chests is increased by 25%
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_greed.4: 4. Gain Hero of the Village V
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_greed.6: 6. Restore 5 health for each item picked up (10 second cooldown)
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_gluttony:
"If you are one who eats too much, put a knife to your throat."
"Whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God."
After the glutton's feast has ended,
a mouthful of clear spring water surpasses a thousand casks of wine.
- Proverbs 23:2 / 1 Corinthians 10:31
1. While your hunger is full, +10% final damage
2. While saturation is full, damage taken is reduced by 5%
3. Eating food restores health equal to its nutrition
4. While your hunger is full, +10% movement speed
6. Eating golden food grants Regeneration III
7. You can eat even when your hunger is full
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_lust.lor:
"Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God."
"I made a covenant with my eyes not to look lustfully at a young woman."
The mist clears from the lake's mirror, revealing what is true;
gazing becomes watching over.
- Matthew 5:8 / Job 31:1
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_lust.1: 1. Drops from killing animals are doubled
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_lust.2: 2. Taking damage grants Regeneration I (5 seconds, 60 second cooldown)
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_lust.3: 3. Neutral creatures deal half damage to you
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_lust.4: 4. Piglin bartering yields doubled results for you
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_lust.5: 5. Your first strike when entering combat deals +100% damage (180s cooldown; kills reset it)
item.book_of_sins.reversal_tome_lust.6: 6. Gain a permanent random positive buff, re-rolled every hour

gui.book_of_sins.root_of_sin.bonus_hint: The deeper the burden, the deeper fate's reward
item.book_of_sins.fallen_skull.3: Damaging a non-undead target afflicts it with 50% Grievous Wounds
item.book_of_sins.abyssal_talon.3: Attacks strip 50% of the target's armor for 5s
item.book_of_sins.final_canto.6: Your first strike in combat grants Star Blessing, Star Sage and Star Redemption
item.book_of_sins.day_clamor.3: Attacks shut down the target's AI
item.book_of_sins.night_hush.3: Attacks deal void damage equal to 0.1% of the target's max health
